title: kit.search-index.v2
description: /search-index.json, written by `kit site build` (writeSearchIndex) for every kit site and read by the shell's search (assets/shell.js): the pages [url, title, headings, description], an inverted index of body terms, the sections and facets the dialog filters by, synonym groups, and per page its section, weight and facet values (meta). Generated, never hand-edited. The cross-field rules a schema cannot say (one meta row per page, every index in range) are checked by checkSearchIndex.

sections.description: [id, label] in the order of the chips.

values.description: [id, label, position, synonyms?]; the position is the value's number across all facets, as meta lists it.

meta.description: Per page, in the order of pages: [section number (-1: none), weight, facet value positions].
